audience: agencies and firms that run client portals with groups, files and tasks in Clinked

useCases.title: Find overdue tasks in client groups
useCases.text: List the accounts and groups, then the tasks of one group with their due dates and status. Open one task for its assignees.

useCases.title: Find the latest file about a topic
useCases.text: Search files, notes and discussions by text. Read the details of one file and its earlier versions.

useCases.title: Read a discussion and its replies
useCases.text: List the discussions of a group, then read one with its replies and the comments on it.

useCases.title: Review who viewed or changed what
useCases.text: List the audit entries of an account for up to three months. Read the account members to match the names.

useCases.title: Check events and new notifications
useCases.text: List the account events in a date range, and the group events of one group. List the new notifications of the connected user.
